question: Women elected to the 18th Lok Sabha in the 2024 General Elections constituted approximately what percentage of the total strength of the House?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.1363**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The total number of seats in the **Lok Sabha** is **543.**
 
• The number of women elected to the **18th Lok Sabha in the 2024 General Elections** is considered as a fraction of the total strength.
 
• The percentage calculation involves dividing the number of women elected by the total Lok Sabha strength and then multiplying by 100.
 
• The approximate value comes out to be **0.1363**, which is equivalent to **13.63%.**
 
• This percentage reflects the **representation of women** in the Lok Sabha during the 2024 General Elections.
 
• The increase in women representation is a significant step towards **gender equality and inclusion** in Indian politics.
 
• The calculation supports the importance of analyzing representation and diversity in the legislative process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **0.1025**__

 __
 
• This percentage reflects a smaller representation of women. It would mean approximately **10.25% of the total Lok Sabha strength.**
 
 
 
• **0.12**__
 __
 
• This is closer to the correct value but still slightly lower than the actual representation of **women in the 18th Lok Sabha.**
 
 
 
• **0.155**__
 
 
• This percentage exceeds the actual value, indicating a hypothetical scenario where **15.5% of the Lok Sabha members** were women.
